summary: Backend-only testing of new AI decision_support endpoint. Created pytest suite (14 tests). All pass on retest: owner doctor jyothi gets rich Markdown advisory with remedies/tinctures/disclaimer (>500 chars), DOCTOR hemanth can invoke on own cases but gets 403/404 on others, invalid action returns 400 with 'Invalid action', PRO/RECEPTION/PHARMACY/ADMIN roles get 403, existing summarize/advice/instructions actions still work, audit log entry AI_USED for Case with action=decision_support is created and retrievable via /api/admin/audit-logs?action=AI_USED, and regression on GET /api/cases and GET /api/cases/{id} still returns 200.
critical_code_review_comments: ai.py handles fallback to Emergent key cleanly when own key fails — good.
_build_clinical_dossier caps text lengths per section, keeping context manageable — good.
Note: GET /api/cases/{id} returns wrapped payload {case, clinical_notes, latest_prescription, payment, attachments}. Existing behavior, unchanged; documented in test.
test_credentials: admin1, jyothi, hemanth, reception1, pharmacy1, pro1 — all with Password@123
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded cases (57 CASE-000xxx).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoint POST /api/cases/{case_id}/ai/decision_support fully verified. Audit logs are queryable via /api/admin/audit-logs?action=AI_USED&limit=N and returned under key `audit_logs`. Response for GET /api/cases/{id} is wrapped (top-level key `case`). AI calls take 15-40s; tests use TIMEOUT=90s. Full suite completes in ~2.5 min.
